title: You’re not just struggling…
paragraphs:
You’re not just struggling…
you’re being exposed.

Not by the enemy.
By God.
Because deep down… you know this season is different.

This isn’t just stress.
This isn’t just bad luck.
This feels like everything hidden is being dragged into the light.

The cravings.
The pride.
The secret compromises.
The version of you no one sees…
is now the version you can’t escape.

Why the wilderness?
Why the silence?
Why the stripping?
Because in comfort, you can pretend.
Old habits call your name like they never left.
You’re face to face with a truth you don’t like:
You’re not as strong as you thought.
“Remember how the Lord your God led you all the way in the wilderness these forty years, to humble and test you… to know what was in your heart.” — Deuteronomy 8:2
And maybe that’s what’s happening to you right now.

Your patience is thin.
Your faith feels weak.
Your discipline is inconsistent.
and you don’t like what you see.

Forty days.
No food.
No shortcuts.
“After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.” — Matthew 4:2
This is where most of us fall.
Because temptation doesn’t feel like rebellion.
“Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.” — Matthew 4:4
You were never meant to survive your wilderness alone.
Because if your salvation depended on your strength—
But Jesus stepped into your testing…
“God made Him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.” — 2 Corinthians 5:21
So what if your struggle isn’t the end?
Because God is not exposing you to shame you.
He’s exposing you to heal you.
That secret sin you keep feeding?
That version of you you’re trying to maintain?
It’s keeping you from the real life Christ offers.
What is your wilderness revealing right now?
Where have you been relying on yourself instead of Christ?
You are not too far gone.
Jesus already stepped into the wilderness for you.
Already won what you keep losing.
because you’ll need this reminder again.
